Our mission is to finance, structure, and mobilize capital for companies and projects that support economic growth, resilience, and long-term development across the region. IDB Invest operates in 26 countries, structured across four geographic regions and three industry verticals: Infrastructure and Energy, Financial Institutions, and Corporates. As part of its evolving business model, “Originate to Share,” IDB Invest is expanding its capacity to mobilize private capital and scale development impact across Latin America and the Caribbean, supported by a $3.5 billion capitalization from its shareholders. The model strengthens IDB Invest’s ability to originate high-quality assets, structure innovative financial solutions, and connect global capital with opportunities across the region. Responsibilities To deliver on the above-mentioned, “Originate to Share” business model, IDB Invest has reorganized its structure. As part of this transformation, the newly created Regions Department (RGS), in partnership with the public‑sector arm of the IDB Group, manages relationships with national governments through dual reporting and oversight of the IDB Group Country Representatives. Additionally, RGS, under dual reporting with the Industries and Cross‑Cutting Themes Department (ICT), supervises the Delivery Units responsible for executing operational programs, managing client relationships at the country level, and leading upstream pipeline development for IDB Invest. RGS is composed by four Divisions as follows: Southern Cone Division: Argentina, Brazil, Chile, Paraguay, and Uruguay Andean Region Division: Bolivia, Colombia, Ecuador, Peru, and Venezuela. Caribbean Division: The Bahamas, Barbados, Guyana, Jamaica, Suriname, and Trinidad and Tobago. Central America Division: Belize, Costa Rica, Dominican Republic, El Salvador, Guatemala, Haiti, Honduras, Mexico, Nicaragua, and Panama. The Industries and Cross Cutting Themes Department (ICT) manages business and client engagement from an industry perspective. It is composed of six divisions: three focused on core industries (Infrastructure and Energy, Financial Institutions, and Corporates); two focused on cross-cutting themes (Climate and Environment and Economic Opportunities); and one dedicated to Portfolio Management. About This Position The Corporates Division (SMC), part of the Industries and Cross-Cutting Themes Department, leads the origination and delivery of operations in agribusiness, manufacturing, tourism and digital economy. The Central America Division (RID) and the Andean Region Division (RAN), part of the Regions Department, are responsible for managing business and client engagement from a country perspective within its member countries. They also provide oversight to the Country Representatives of the IDB’s Vice Presidency for Countries and to the Directors of Delivery Units at IDB Invest. The Delivery Units are responsible for: (i) establishing and maintaining client relationships, (ii) building pipeline through upstream project and sector development, (iii) transaction execution through the incorporation of multiple financial products including loans, guarantees, debt capital markets, equity and quasi-equity instruments, as well as resource mobilization and technical cooperation and (iv) acting as the center of institutional knowledge and expertise for the sectors covered by the Division. This integrated model enables Delivery Units to align business development with strategic priorities, enhance regional coordination, and ensure operational effectiveness across IDB Invest. You will report to the Director of the Delivery Unit that has a dual-reporting structure to both the Managing Director of the Corporates Division (SMC) and the Managing Director of the relevant regional division (RID or RAN). What you’ll do As Senior Investment Associate , your scope of activities shall include, but not be limited to: Demonstrate a thorough understanding of finance and financial services, especially corporate and project financing. Support the regional team leaders in developing and maintaining quality client relationships to ensure responsive client service and improve new business opportunities. Review and analyze financial statements and build and/or adjust Excel financial models, including financial projection models, to evaluate financial information and support management decision-making. Proactively identify potential investment opportunities based on industry experience, reputation, market potential, financial capability, and strategic fit. Assess the attractiveness of specific investment opportunities with a strong focus on credit quality and development impact including creating financial models, analyzing historical and projected financial models and conducting industry and market research and assisting in IDB Invest’s business development efforts. Participate in negotiations; use negotiation skills to overcome impasses and lead negotiations in straightforward transactions. When required and under the supervision of the team leader, coordinate complete transactions (including in person due diligences) and develop appropriate financial structures for straightforward and sophisticated transactions, including all the internal transaction management. Work closely with IDB Invest’s development partners to manage environmental, social, technical, legal, corporate governance, and other risks in projects and champion IDB Invest’s offerings to clients. Prepare documentation for IDB Invest internal processes and contribute to the preparation and review of legal transaction documents, ensuring accuracy and compliance with IDB Invest standards. Assist with disbursements for approved lending and investment transactions by assisting with the verification of all contractual conditions. Assist in the preparation of PowerPoint presentations, Excel spreadsheets, pitchbooks, and other business-related reports in the day-to-day operations of the Unit. What you'll need Education: An advanced degree (Masters, MBA, or equivalent) in economics, legal, finance, business administration, engineering, or another relevant field. Experience: At least five (3) years of relevant professional experience in loan and investments origination, structuring structured finance (project finance), or corporate finance transactions. Confirmed experience in a similar role in an investment, advisory firm, or development bank would be desirable. Strong client relationship experience and skills are also highly valued. Language Skills: Oral and written professional proficiency in English and Spanish required. Requirements Citizenship: Must be eligible to work in job location without the need for sponsorship. Consanguinity: You have no family members (up to fourth degree of consanguinity and second degree of affinity, including spouse) working at the IDB, IDB Invest, or IDB Lab. Type of contract and duration National staff contract, 36 months initially, renewable upon mutual agreement. What we offer The IDB group provides benefits that respond to the different needs and moments of an employee's life. These benefits include: A competitive compensation package. Leaves and vacations: 24 days of paid time off + 8 personal days + sick leave + gender-neutral parental leave. Health Insurance: IDB Group provides employees and eligible dependents with a robust medical benefits program that covers medical, dental, vision, preventive care, and prescription drugs. Pension plan: defined benefit pension plan that provides financial security and support employees in planning for their future. Hybrid and flexible work schedules. Health and well-being: Access to our Health Services Center that provides preventive care and health education for employees. Development support: We offer tools to boost your professional profile, such as mentoring, 1:1 professional counseling, training and learning opportunities, language classes, mobility options, among others. Our culture At the IDB, we work so everyone brings their best and authentic selves to work while finding their purpose. Our people consistently strive for excellence, and we recognize and celebrate the impact of their contributions. In our efforts to drive innovation, we intentionally include all voices, cultivate a sense of belonging and champion fairness. We welcome individuals from underrepresented groups to join us and share their unique perspectives. We ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job interview process. If you require an accommodation to complete this application, please email us at accommodations@iadb.org. #idbinvest

review_candidates.title: HR Business Partner
review_candidates.description: Role Summary To manage day-to-day HR operations across Bahrain and UAE, including the administration of HR policies, procedures, HRIS records and HR programmes in consultation with HR Management. The role acts as a trusted HR Business Partner to assigned departments, providing practical, proactive and business-focused advice across the employee lifecycle. It partners with line managers to strengthen employee relations, performance management, talent development, engagement and HR compliance, while using HR data and employee insights to identify trends, highlight risks and recommend timely actions. Strategic Responsibilities Partner with business heads and managers to understand operational priorities and translate them into practical people plans. Build trusted relationships across the business and influence stakeholders through sound judgement, data-led insights and clear communication. Support the development, review and implementation of Bahrain/GCC specific HR policies, procedures and employee communication materials in coordination with HR Management. Provide high-quality, efficient and business-focused HR advisory support across employee relations, performance, engagement, retention and workforce planning. Support succession planning activities in partnership with business leaders, providing workforce insights and recommendations to support operational and strategic requirements. Strengthen the employee life cycle experience, from onboarding and probation through development, performance, recognition and exit. Coach managers on people decisions, feedback conversations, employee engagement, documentation standards and consistent policy application. Identify HR process improvement opportunities and support regional initiatives that improve efficiency, compliance and employee experience. Support the implementation of organisational change, HR transformation and continuous improvement initiatives, partnering with business leaders to embed new processes, practices and ways of working that enhance organisational effectiveness and employee experience. Operational Responsibilities Employee Life Cycle and Employee Experience Lead the induction, onboarding and new joiner experience, ensuring all joining formalities, orientation activities, documentation and probation follow-ups are completed on time. Conduct employee induction, confirmation, transfer and exit discussions, documenting key outcomes and maintaining relevant records appropriately. Manage employee communications, including one-to-one sessions, team briefings and written updates, based on business and employee needs. Support internal audits and the sales team through completion of pre-qualification templates for tendering. Learning, Engagement and Recognition Coordinate training requirements with managers, source and liaise with vendors, manage nominations and attendance, collect feedback and submit regular reports to HR Management. Vendor coordination for certificates as needed. Support learning and development initiatives by communicating available opportunities and encouraging employee participation. Lead the existing practice of learning and development (Taqadam). Lead employee engagement initiatives for assigned business areas, including planning, budget proposals, implementation, feedback capture and post-activity review including managing Intranet page for HR updates. Drive employee rewards and recognition (Mashkoor) processes for the company, ensuring consistency, fairness and timely communication, tracking, reporting etc. Performance Management and Employee Relations Support and lead location-specific performance management cycles, manager guidance sessions and employee discussions. Support disciplinary investigations and grievance matters in consultation with HR Management, ensuring confidentiality, fairness, complete documentation and alignment with policy and applicable labour requirements. Prepare and issue official internal HR documents such as compensation and benefits letters, warning letters, employment-related letters and other employee communications in consultation with HR Management. HRIS, Reporting and Analytics Maintain accurate HRIS data and employee records by ensuring timely updates, validation and documentation control. Assist in the regular review, testing and implementation of HRIS upgrades, coordinating with functional and technical teams where required. Deliver routine monthly HR reports, and respond to basic to intermediate ad hoc data, reporting and analysis requests from HR Management. Track HR metrics such as headcount movement, attrition, absence, engagement feedback, training participation and employee relations themes, and share insights for management action. Compliance, Advisory and Continuous Improvement Respond to employee and manager inquiries, complaints or concerns by providing accurate information on benefits, policies and procedures, in close coordination with HR Management. Maintain awareness of current HR trends, labour market practices and regulatory developments in Bahrain and the wider GCC region, and share recommendations on talent, engagement, training, process improvement and data analysis. Perform other duties as requested by HR Management. Candidate Requirements Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or related discipline; Minimum 5+ years of progressive HR generalist/business partnering experience, preferably in a multi-location or project-based environment. Strong working knowledge of HR operations, employee relations, performance management, onboarding, engagement, HR reporting and policy implementation. High level of confidentiality, discretion and professional judgement when handling employee matters, sensitive information and management discussions. Knowledge of Bahrain/ UAE labour law and GCC HR practices is preferred. Experience working with HRIS systems and employee data; ability to prepare accurate reports and translate data into practical insights. Compensation and benefits knowledge or certification is an advantage. Ability to create, develop and deploy HR programs with clear planning, stakeholder alignment and follow-through. Travel 10% of the time as needed for the business including periodic travel to project sites or regional offices, where required. Candidate Competency Summary Business partnering mindset and stakeholder management. Problem solving and sound judgement. Achievement orientation and execution excellence. Employee relations handling and conflict resolution. Coaching, negotiation and influencing skills. Clear spoken and written communication in English; local language capability is an advantage. Data orientation, reporting accuracy and HRIS discipline. Teamwork, collaboration and networking skills. Innovation, creativity and continuous improvement mindset. Understanding of the interiors, construction, fit-out or project-based industry environment is an advantage.

review_candidates.title: Global Compensation Senior Manager
review_candidates.description: Location: Madrid, ES, 28033 Flexible Work Arrangement: Hybrid Job Category: Human Resources Career Level: Professional Requisition Id: 6577 Since 1967, Jet Aviation has been crafting flight in its smoothest form. From one hangar in Basel, Switzerland, to over 5,000 employees, and some 50 locations worldwide. Aircraft Management, Aircraft Sales, Charter, Completions, Government Services, FBO, Fixed and Rotary Wing Maintenance, and Staffing. Behind every seamless Jet Aviation experience, is a team of dedicated professionals perfecting the art of flight. The artisans of aviation. The craft that brings our customers’ journey to life. In the hangar, on the ground, and behind the scenes. Enabling global flight, with passion. Position Summary As our global compensation expert, you will play a key role in defining and delivering a global compensation strategy that attracts, motivates, and rewards our people. Working across countries, functions, and cultures, you will ensure our compensation programs are competitive, equitable, transparent, compliant, and closely aligned with our business priorities and values. From job architecture and salary structures to annual compensation cycles, market benchmarking, pay equity, and M&A integration, you will lead high-impact initiatives that influence the employee experience across the organization. As a trusted subject matter expert and strategic partner to HR, Total Rewards, and business leaders, you will turn complex compensation data and regulations into clear recommendations and meaningful business solutions. This is an opportunity to make a visible global impact and help shape a total rewards environment that supports both our employees and Jet Aviation’s continued success. Your Role Set the global compensation strategy: Develop and lead global, regional, and local compensation programs that are market competitive and aligned with business priorities, operational goals, company values, and culture. Own the global compensation framework: Lead the design and governance of job architecture, job leveling, salary structures, and compensation principles across the organization. Lead annual compensation cycles: Plan and manage merit, bonus, and equity cycles, including tools, timelines, training, communication, and execution. Oversee market benchmarking: Manage global market pricing, salary benchmarking, and compensation survey participation to support competitive pay practices. Provide compensation expertise: Advise HR and Total Rewards partners on salary offers, pay decisions, retention actions, and other compensation-related matters, while supporting executive compensation activities. Ensure regulatory compliance: Monitor global compensation legislation and ensure alignment with pay transparency, equal pay, wage compliance, and other applicable requirements. Partner with regional teams: Collaborate with regional HR and Total Rewards leaders to maintain pay competitiveness and ensure the effective execution of compensation programs. Deliver compensation analytics: Lead the development and distribution of compensation dashboards, analytics, reporting, and pay equity reviews to support data-driven decision-making. Support M&A activities: Lead global compensation due diligence and integration activities related to mergers and acquisitions. Represent Jet Aviation globally: Act as a trusted representative of Jet Aviation internally and externally with industry groups, regulatory bodies, and the General Dynamics network. Your Profile You hold a bachelor’s degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business, or a related discipline. You bring at least seven years of experience in Human Resources and compensation, with extensive knowledge of compensation practices, principles, and regulations. You have proven experience designing, developing, implementing, and administering compensation programs that support organizational culture, values, and business strategy. You have knowledge of international regulatory environments and their impact on compensation programs. You are highly proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, and are comfortable working with HR information systems. You have strong project management and prioritization skills, enabling you to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines effectively. You communicate clearly and confidently, both verbally and in writing, and can build strong partnerships with stakeholders at all levels. You demonstrate excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a highly detail-oriented and accurate approach. You are collaborative, pragmatic, and able to work effectively across countries, functions, and cultures. Your personal values align with Jet Aviation’s values of Trust, Honesty, Alignment, and Transparency. Why Join Us Work with influence: Partner with senior stakeholders and regional teams, advising on decisions that directly affect our people, business performance, and ability to attract top talent. Turn insight into action: Use your analytical expertise to transform complex data into practical recommendations and meaningful improvements. Be part of something bigger: Collaborate across Jet Aviation and the wider General Dynamics network, gaining exposure to different perspectives, markets, and business environments. If you are a strategic, analytical, and collaborative compensation expert who is passionate about creating fair, competitive, and impactful rewards programs, we would love to hear from you.

review_candidates.title: Global Assistant Brand & Product Manager
review_candidates.description: We are rebel watchmakers with a purpose. Established in 1854 as the Waterbury Clock Company, we took a traditional European watchmaking and layered American industrial ingenuity on top. That is when we began our journey to disrupt a 300-year-old industry. Timex took mantle clocks made from wood and made them out of metal and made them faster and affordable for everyone. We took the pocket watch, added a strap, and put it on your wrist. Today our design lab in Milan designs the most beautiful watches for consumers around the world. Come join our team, make a difference, and wear watches from Timex and some of the biggest brands in the world. **This role is hybrid and requires 2 days a week on-site in our Milan office.** Summary We’re looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Global Assistant Brand & Product Manager to support our global brands across product development, brand management, marketing and business analysis. This role will help bring seasonal collections to market, coordinate marketing activities and turn sales data and market insights into practical recommendations. Working with colleagues and partners around the world, the role helps ensure that products and communications reflect each brand’s identity and positioning. Join our global team at our headquarters in Milan, reporting directly to the Global Brand Director. Work closely with Design, Product Development, Planning and Sales teams, as well as creative and PR agencies, affiliates and partners. The role includes regular collaboration with colleagues in Hong Kong and the United States. Responsibilities Product Development: Coordinate with the Product Development team in Hong Kong and the Design team to help keep seasonal collections on schedule. Collection Planning: Use sales analysis, market feedback and brand objectives to support product briefs for new collections. Product Setup: Create and maintain product, display and packaging codes for new collections in Oracle and PIM. Planning Coordination: Work with the Planning team to monitor collection status, open-to-buy planning and stock levels. Sales Support: Help present new collections and deliver product training to sales teams. Packaging and Displays: Prepare briefs for packaging, displays and other supporting materials, working with development teams in the US and Hong Kong. Business Analysis: Prepare dashboards, business reviews and brand presentations covering performance, product portfolios, market positioning, consumer insights and competitor activity. Marketing Coordination: Develop brand and communication briefs and work with creative and PR agencies on campaigns, photo shoots, presentations and marketing assets. Partner Support: Support affiliates and partners with local marketing activities and share successful examples across markets. Marketing Plans and Brand Assets: Coordinate annual marketing plans and budget presentations. Keep the Brand Playbook, product information, images and communication assets up to date on TGA and other relevant platforms . Requirements Ideally, Master of Science or a related field. 1–2 years of experience in brand management, product management or marketing in an international environment. Experience in watches and jewelry, eyewear, beauty, fashion or accessories would be an advantage. Strong analytical skills and the ability to turn data into clear business recommendations. Excellent Excel and PowerPoint skills, with a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office. Confidence using AI tools to support your work. Strong communication, presentation and relationship-building skills. A proactive, curious and flexible approach, with a commitment to teamwork. Good organizational skills, attention to detail and a commercial mindset. The ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and meet tight deadlines. A practical approach to solving problems and sound judgement when making decisions. Fluency in English and Italian. An interview in English will form part of the recruitment process. Wage Range: €30,000–€35,000 gross annual base salary (RAL), depending on relevant experience. Timex Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.
